DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({"Non OMIS"}, 'Dim KPI List'[Uses OMIS data])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable2 = 
		TREATAS({2026}, 'dim_calender_date'[year])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable3 = 
		TREATAS({TRUE}, 'dim_plant_hierarchy'[is_rollout_scope_dax])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable4 = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(
				SUMMARIZE(
					VALUES('dim_plant_hierarchy'),
					'dim_plant_hierarchy'[region_desc],
					'dim_plant_hierarchy'[area_desc]
				)
			),
			OR(
				'dim_plant_hierarchy'[region_desc] IN {"OSM Region Europe",
					"Region Other Business"},
				('dim_plant_hierarchy'[region_desc], 'dim_plant_hierarchy'[area_desc]) IN {("OMN Region Europe", "OMN REU East Europe"),
					("OMN Region Europe", "OMN REU Middle East & Africa"),
					("OMN Region Europe", "OMN REU West Europe"),
					("OMN Region Europe", "OMN REU Central & North Europe")}
			)
		)

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Dim KPI List'[KPI Type],
			'Dim KPI List'[KPI code],
			'Dim KPI List'[KPI Description],
			'dim_plant_hierarchy'[plant_cod],
			__DS0FilterTable,
			__DS0FilterTable2,
			__DS0FilterTable3,
			__DS0FilterTable4,
			"Actual_KPIs_Switch", '_Measures'[Actual KPIs Switch]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(
			101,
			SUMMARIZE(
				__DS0Core,
				'Dim KPI List'[KPI Type],
				'Dim KPI List'[KPI code],
				'Dim KPI List'[KPI Description]
			),
			'Dim KPI List'[KPI Type],
			1,
			'Dim KPI List'[KPI Description],
			1,
			'Dim KPI List'[KPI code],
			1
		)

	VAR __DS0SecondaryBase = 
		SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'dim_plant_hierarchy'[plant_cod])

	VAR __DS0Secondary = 
		TOPN(102, __DS0SecondaryBase, 'dim_plant_hierarchy'[plant_cod], 1)

	VAR __DS0BodyLimited = 
		NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(
			__DS0PrimaryWindowed,
			SUBSTITUTEWITHINDEX(
				__DS0Core,
				"ColumnIndex",
				__DS0Secondary,
				'dim_plant_hierarchy'[plant_cod],
				ASC
			)
		)

EVALUATE
	__DS0Secondary

ORDER BY
	'dim_plant_hierarchy'[plant_cod]

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyLimited

ORDER BY
	'Dim KPI List'[KPI Type],
	'Dim KPI List'[KPI Description],
	'Dim KPI List'[KPI code],
	[ColumnIndex]
